data.name: Bahriah
data.gender_notes: Bahriah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'Bahar' meaning 'spring' or 'abundance'. The name Bahriah signifies radiance and shining, reflecting the abundance and fertility of nature. The name Bahriah carries the meaning “Radiant, Shining” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Bahriah usually hope their child will grow to embody radiant, shining and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the inner radiance and shining of a person, representing their connection to the divine.
data.etymology: Bahriah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Radiant, Shining.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bahriah total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: بَحْرِيَّة
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مؤنث مشتق من البحر، يعني البحرية أو ذات البحر
in_arabic.long_meaning: بَحْرِيَّة هو اسم علم مؤنث عربي، مشتق من كلمة البحر، و يعني البحرية أو ذات البحر. وردت الكلمة في القرآن الكريم في سياق الحديث عن البحر ومخلوقاته، وترمز إلى العظمة والقدرة الإلهية. يستخدم الاسم في الثقافة الإسلامية ليدل على الجمال والعمق، ويحمل دلالة روحية عميقة.

in_urdu.name: بحریہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: بحریہ ایک مؤنث نام ہے جو بحر (سمندر) سے نکلا ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے سمندری یا بحر سے متعلق۔ یہ نام عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے اور اسلامی ثقافت میں اس کا استعمال بحر کی عظمت اور قدرت کو ظاہر کرنے کے لئے کیا جاتا ہے۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کے لئے روحانی اور ثقافتی اہمیت رکھتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: बहरीया
in_hindi.long_meaning: बहरीया एक स्त्रीलिंग नाम है जो 'बह्र' (समुद्र) से व्युत्पन्न है। इसका अर्थ है समुद्र से संबंधित या सागर की। यह नाम इस्लामी संस्कृति में समुद्र की महत्ता और ईश्वरीय शक्ति को दर्शाने के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में यह नाम आध्यात्मिक और सांस्कृतिक महत्व रखता है।

in_pashto.name: بحرېه
in_pashto.long_meaning: بحرېه يو مؤنث نوم دے چې د بحر (سمندر) څخه اخیستل شوی دے. دا مطلب لري سمندري یا د بحر پورې اړوند. دا نوم عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دے او د اسلامي کلتور کې د بحر د عظمت او قدرت د ښودلو لپاره کارول کیږي. دا نوم د افغان او پښتون قومونو لپاره روحاني او کلتوري اهميت لري.

in_english.name: Bahriah
in_english.long_meaning: Bahriah is a feminine given name derived from the Arabic word 'baḥr' (بحر), meaning 'sea' or 'ocean'. The name symbolizes vastness, depth, and the power of the sea. In Islamic tradition, it reflects the Quranic references to the sea and its creatures, signifying God's creation and authority. The name Bahriah carries spiritual significance, representing beauty, serenity, and the mysteries of the ocean. It is used across various Muslim cultures, embodying a connection to maritime heritage and the natural world.

historical_references.reference: Bahriah was the name of a tribe known for their military prowess and were among the earliest converts to Islam. They played a significant role in the Battle of Badr (624 AD) under the command of Muhammad (PBUH).
historical_references.context: Early Islamic history, Military and Political

historical_references.reference: Bahriah was also the name of a city located in Egypt, which was the capital of the Fatimid Caliphate from 969 to 1171 AD. During this period, Bahriah was a major center of learning and culture, with numerous mosques, universities, and libraries.
historical_references.context: Medieval Islamic history, Cultural and Educational
